comparison.objective: Place a nickel strip and spot-weld it to four battery cells; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip alignment and repeated two-probe contact at four sites versus recessed tool use, collar adjustment and cyclic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Strip aligned, four weld sites completed and tool returned versus safe stopping response on two cycles and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Different process, contact pattern and success evidence. The simulation’s weld is contact-based, but that limitation does not create overlap.
